rv.q: You gotta want to spend time with those songs, but this cast will make sure you have fun if you do.
Buddy - The Buddy Holly Story is an easy show to wholeheartedly suggest - a colorful, high-energy celebration of a musical pioneer whose influence still echoes across generations.
This musical dazzles with electrifying performances that will ignite the theater and leave you craving more.
Drury Lane Theatre in Oakbrook is presenting a solid production of Alan Janes' "Buddy -The Buddy Holly Story".

It is not a penetrating biography, and it isn't particularly interested in psychological complexity. Its jukebox construction can feel mechanical, its storytelling is often skeletal and its radio-DJ narrator is largely superfluous.
